trending.name: lvgl
trending.author: kisvegabor
trending.sentence: Full-featured Graphics Library for Embedded Systems
trending.paragraph: Powerful and easy-to-use embedded GUI with many widgets, advanced visual effects (opacity, antialiasing, animations) and low memory requirements (16K RAM, 64K Flash).

trending.name: FastLED
trending.author: Daniel Garcia
trending.sentence: Multi-platform library for controlling dozens of different types of LEDs along with optimized math, effect, and noise functions.
trending.paragraph: FastLED is a fast, efficient, easy-to-use Arduino library for programming addressable LED strips and pixels such as WS2810, WS2811, LPD8806, Neopixel and more. FastLED also provides high-level math functions that can be used for generative art and graphics.

trending.name: WiFiManager
trending.author: tzapu
trending.sentence: WiFi Configuration manager with web configuration portal for Espressif ESPx boards, by tzapu
trending.paragraph: Library for configuring ESP8266/ESP32 modules WiFi credentials and custom parameters at runtime with captive portal.

trending.name: ArduinoJson
trending.author: Benoit Blanchon <blog.benoitblanchon.fr>
trending.sentence: A simple and efficient JSON library for embedded C++.
trending.paragraph: ⭐ 7124 stars on GitHub! Supports serialization, deserialization, MessagePack, streams, filtering, and more. Fully tested and documented.

trending.name: Blinker
trending.author: i3water
trending.sentence: Build a easy way for your IoT project.
trending.paragraph: Blinker library for embedded hardware. Support Arduino, ESP8266, ESP32, WiFi, BLE, MQTT.

trending.name: IRremote
trending.author: shirriff, z3t0, ArminJo
trending.sentence: Send and receive infrared signals with multiple protocols
trending.paragraph: Currently included protocols: Denon / Sharp, JVC, LG,  NEC / Onkyo / Apple, Panasonic / Kaseikyo, RC5, RC6, Samsung, Sony, (Pronto), BangOlufsen, BoseWave, Lego, Whynter, FAST, MagiQuest, Velux, Universal Pulse Distance and Pulse Width.

trending.name: TFT_eSPI
trending.author: Bodmer
trending.sentence: TFT graphics library for Arduino processors with performance optimisation for RP2040, STM32, ESP8266 and ESP32
trending.paragraph: Supports TFT displays using drivers (ILI9341 etc.) that operate with hardware SPI or 8/16-bit parallel.

trending.name: PubSubClient
trending.author: Nick O'Leary <nick.oleary@gmail.com>
trending.sentence: A client library for MQTT messaging.
trending.paragraph: MQTT is a lightweight messaging protocol ideal for small devices. This library allows you to send and receive MQTT messages. It supports the latest MQTT 3.1.1 protocol and can be configured to use the older MQTT 3.1 if needed. It supports all Arduino Ethernet Client compatible hardware, including the Intel Galileo/Edison, ESP8266 and TI CC3000.

trending.name: Blynk
trending.author: Blynk
trending.sentence: Build a smartphone app for your project in minutes!
trending.paragraph: It supports  WiFi, Ethernet, Cellular connectivity. Works with over 400 boards like ESP8266, ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Particle, etc.

trending.name: IRremoteESP8266
trending.author: David Conran, Sebastien Warin, Mark Szabo, Ken Shirriff
trending.maintainer: David Conran, Mark Szabo, Sebastien Warin, Roi Dayan, Massimiliano Pinto, Christian Nilsson
trending.sentence: Send and receive infrared signals with multiple protocols (ESP8266/ESP32)
trending.paragraph: This library enables you to send and receive infra-red signals on an ESP8266 or an ESP32.

trending.name: Adafruit NeoPixel
trending.author: Adafruit
trending.sentence: Arduino library for controlling single-wire-based LED pixels and strip.
trending.paragraph: Arduino library for controlling single-wire-based LED pixels and strip.

trending.name: MFRC522
trending.author: GithubCommunity
trending.sentence: Arduino RFID Library for MFRC522 (SPI)
trending.paragraph: Read/Write a RFID Card or Tag using the ISO/IEC 14443A/MIFARE interface.

trending.name: Simple FOC
trending.author: Simplefoc <info@simplefoc.com>
trending.sentence: A library demistifying FOC for BLDC motors
trending.paragraph: Simple library intended for hobby comunity to run the BLDC and Stepper motor using FOC algorithm. It is intended to support as many BLDC/Stepper motor+sensor+driver combinations as possible and in the same time maintain simplicity of usage. Library supports Arudino devices such as Arduino UNO, MEGA, NANO and similar, stm32 boards such as Nucleo and Bluepill, ESP32 and Teensy boards.

trending.name: Adafruit GFX Library
trending.author: Adafruit
trending.sentence: Adafruit GFX graphics core library, this is the 'core' class that all our other graphics libraries derive from.
trending.paragraph: Install this library in addition to the display library for your hardware.

trending.name: PJON
trending.author: Giovanni Blu Mitolo <gioscarab@gmail.com>
trending.sentence: PJON is an open-source, multi-master, multi-media bus network protocol
trending.paragraph: It is a valid alternative to i2c, 1-Wire, CAN and other protocols

trending.name: Watchy
trending.author: SQFMI
trending.sentence: Watchy - An Open Source E-Paper Watch by SQFMI
trending.paragraph: This library contains drivers and code samples for Watchy

trending.name: HID-Project
trending.author: NicoHood
trending.sentence: Extended HID Functions for Arduino
trending.paragraph: Includes BootKeyboard/Mouse, Consumer, System, Gamepad, RawHID and more features. Also compatible with Arduino Uno/Mega via HoodLoader2.

trending.name: RadioLib
trending.author: Jan Gromes <gromes.jan@gmail.com>
trending.sentence: Universal wireless communication library
trending.paragraph: User-friendly library for sub-GHz radio modules (SX1278, RF69, CC1101, SX1268, LR1110, LR2021 and many others), as well as ham radio digital modes (RTTY, SSTV, AX.25 etc.) and other protocols (Pagers, LoRaWAN, ADS-B).

trending.name: RF24
trending.author: TMRh20
trending.sentence: Radio driver, OSI layer 2 library for nrf24L01(+) modules.
trending.paragraph: Core library for nRF24L01(+) communication. Simple to use for beginners, but offers advanced configuration options. Many examples are included to demonstrate various modes of communication.

trending.name: ESP8266Audio
trending.author: Earle F. Philhower, III
trending.sentence: Audio file and I2S sound playing routines for ESP8266, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi Pico RP2040
trending.paragraph: Decode compressed MP3, AAC, FLAC, Screamtracker MOD, MIDI, RTTL, TI Talkie, and WAV and play on an I2S DAC or a software-driven delta-sigma DAC and 1-transistor amplifier.

hidden_gems.paragraph: Implements functionality required to create a VLCB module based on MCP2515 and MCP2562 ICs

hidden_gems.name: AxonSDK
hidden_gems.author: AXON Team
hidden_gems.sentence: Client SDK library for AXON IoT Platform connecting ESP32 to database gateway.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Blynk-style library supporting virtual pins, WiFi, MQTT, and automatic callback registrations.

hidden_gems.name: Omiru IoT Platform
hidden_gems.author: Omiru Team

hidden_gems.paragraph: A simple wrapper over Firebase to connect ESP32 hubs and nodes easily to the Omiru Web Dashboard and Mobile App.

hidden_gems.name: AVR Task Scheduler
hidden_gems.author: SUNSET
hidden_gems.sentence: A lightweight, polling-based task scheduler for AVR Arduino boards with FreeRTOS-like API.
hidden_gems.paragraph: This library provides a simple yet powerful task scheduling system for AVR microcontrollers. It uses millis() for timing (no hardware timer required), supports multiple tasks with different intervals, and includes task management features like suspend/resume/delete. Perfect for projects that need to manage multiple periodic tasks without the complexity of RTOS.

hidden_gems.name: HIRO

hidden_gems.paragraph: This library allows ease of use for end users defining and controlling a H.I.R.O. model TR-01-A Robotics Platform using Raspberry pi pico.

hidden_gems.name: OV7725_Camera_Library
hidden_gems.author: HRK YAS
hidden_gems.sentence: CPU-free OV7725 camera streaming library for RP2350
hidden_gems.paragraph: Capture images from OV7725 camera using DMA and PIO with zero CPU overhead. Supports color and monochrome modes at multiple resolutions (QVGA, QQVGA, QQQVGA) with 30fps streaming. Dual-buffer architecture enables simultaneous capture and image processing.

hidden_gems.name: HM01B0_CPUfree_Camera
hidden_gems.author: HRK.yas
hidden_gems.sentence: CPU-free camera streaming for RP2350 using DMA and PIO
hidden_gems.paragraph: Capture images from HM01B0 camera using DMA and PIO with zero CPU overhead. Dual-buffering enables simultaneous camera acquisition and image processing. Supports 15-120fps with multiple resolution modes (QQVGA, QVGA, FULL). Ideal for AI/ML and real-time image processing applications.

hidden_gems.name: NiusWireless
hidden_gems.author: dunknowcoding
hidden_gems.sentence: Unified Arduino driver for RFID-RC522, LoRa, NRF24L01, HC-12, HC-05/06 and PN532.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Cross-platform Arduino library for wireless and RF modules. Drivers include MFRC522 (RFID/NFC over SPI and I2C, with CUID / UFUID / FUID magic-tag support), RFM9x / RA-01 / RA-02 (LoRa 433 / 470 / 868 / 915 MHz), SX1261 / SX1262 / SX1268, NRF24L01 (+), HC-12 long-range serial, HC-05 / HC-06 Bluetooth SPP, and PN532 NFC. Compatible with AVR, SAMD, ESP32, ESP8266, nRF52, STM32, RP2040 / RP2350, Renesas RA (UNO R4) and more.

hidden_gems.name: Ultra1602Ultimate
hidden_gems.author: Moaaz Yahia Sherif
hidden_gems.sentence: A high-performance, flicker-free LCD 1602 library with Smart Refresh and built-in precise progress bars.
hidden_gems.paragraph: This library optimizes LCD1602 performance by using a shadow buffer to refresh only changed characters, eliminating annoying screen flicker. Supports both Native 4-bit and I2C modes, auto-centering text, and custom icons like battery and wifi signal bars without using blocking delays.

hidden_gems.name: RCArmDrive
hidden_gems.author: nthnsdev <pythonprint990@gmail.com>
hidden_gems.sentence: Control an RC car with a robotic crane/arm over BLE, HC-05/HC-06 Bluetooth, or WiFi.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Transport-agnostic library for building RC vehicles with servo-driven crane/arm attachments. Supports ESP32 BLE, HC-05/HC-06 Bluetooth modules, and WiFi, with a unified command protocol and Flutter companion app support.

hidden_gems.name: MyButtons
hidden_gems.author: Vic P.
hidden_gems.sentence: A simple Arduino/ESP32 button library for handling a list of buttons - configure once, trigger a debounced pressed event via callback, or check pressed states anytime.
hidden_gems.paragraph: MyButtons provides an easy-to-use interface for managing multiple GPIO buttons with built-in debounce, edge detection, callback, and polling APIs. Supports up to 64 buttons via bitmask, both active-high (VCC) and active-low (GND) wiring. Works on AVR, ESP32, and any Arduino-compatible board.

hidden_gems.name: BMx280PIO_RP2040
hidden_gems.author: Ângelo Moisés Alves
hidden_gems.sentence: BMP280/BME280 sensor driver for RP2040 with PIO and Wire I2C support
hidden_gems.paragraph: Reads temperature, pressure, and humidity from Bosch BMP280/BME280 sensors. Supports both PIO-based I2C (any GPIO) and hardware I2C (Wire). Auto-detects BMP280 vs BME280. Verified on hardware.

hidden_gems.name: htcw_frame_arq
hidden_gems.author: honey the codewitch
hidden_gems.sentence: Provides data transport framing and error checking with guaranteed delivery
hidden_gems.paragraph: This library provides data transport framing, error checking and guaranteed delivery for dirty comms lines

hidden_gems.name: KenwoodXS
hidden_gems.author: Gaweł Bartosik
hidden_gems.sentence: Arduino library for controlling and monitoring Kenwood audio equipment over the XS System Control bus.
hidden_gems.paragraph: KenwoodXS sends and receives command bytes over the proprietary Kenwood XS two-wire control protocol, with helpers for receiver power, input selection, tape transport, and CD transport commands.

hidden_gems.name: EEPROMPreferences
hidden_gems.author: Péter Soós
hidden_gems.sentence: Preferences-style persistent key/value store backed by AVR EEPROM.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Namespaced key/value storage exposing a Preferences-compatible API subset, so multiplatform sketches can share storage code with ESP32 (native Preferences/NVS) and ESP8266. Log-structured records with CRC-8 integrity and power-loss-safe writes. Keys and namespaces up to 15 chars, values up to 255 bytes. No Arduino String, no thread-safety layer (AVR is single-core).

hidden_gems.name: planterm
hidden_gems.author: Timo Derstappen
hidden_gems.sentence: CAREL pLAN terminal protocol library: act as a pGD terminal to decode, enroll, navigate and edit.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Implements the CAREL pLAN terminal role as reverse-engineered from one uPC controller. Frame grammar, keypad encoding, poll-token matching, stream re-splitting and display-record decode. Header-only, platform-agnostic C++17: bytes in, bytes out; you supply the (9-bit capable) transport.

hidden_gems.name: RobotShield

hidden_gems.sentence: Hardware abstraction library for the UNO Q robot shield (servo, PWM, motor, power telemetry).
hidden_gems.paragraph: Provides servo angle control, raw PWM frequency and pulse management, DC motor H-bridge control, and battery and power telemetry via an I2C co-processor. Designed for the STM32U5 and QCM2290 UNO Q platform communicating over Arduino Bridge RPC.

hidden_gems.name: LynkTuyaLocal
hidden_gems.author: Alex Fichter
hidden_gems.sentence: Control Tuya devices from ESP32 over the local network, without the Tuya cloud.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Implements the Tuya LAN protocol v3.4 and v3.5 directly over TCP: authentication handshake, session key generation, AES-ECB/HMAC-SHA256 (v3.4) and AES-GCM (v3.5) encryption, status requests and power on/off commands. Use TinyTuya to obtain the device IP and Local Key.

hidden_gems.name: ServoTimer2Plus
hidden_gems.author: Michael Margolis, Nick Bontrager,Victor Lelikov <victor.lelikov@protonmail.com>
hidden_gems.sentence: Timer2-based servo library for AVR Arduino boards.
hidden_gems.paragraph: ServoTimer2Plus is a maintained update of the original ServoTimer2 library. It drives standard hobby servos using Timer2 instead of Timer1, leaving Timer1 available for other libraries or application code.

hidden_gems.name: SysUILib
hidden_gems.author: Houslast3 <houslast3@users.noreply.github.com>
hidden_gems.sentence: ESP32 library for ST7789 display, SD card logging, dual ThingSpeak, GPS, and button navigation
hidden_gems.paragraph: Provides a simple API for displaying sensor data on ST7789 (SPI), logging to SD card (CSV), sending to ThingSpeak (two channels), reading GPS (TinyGPS++), and navigating pages with a button. Includes built-in web server (WiFi AP/STA) for configuration and a full SD Card web UI with Chart.js graphs, file download, and delete. Supports simulated sensors, simulated SD (LittleFS), and simulated GPS for testing without hardware.
